Round 4: identified as Helen Ferlaino's baptismal name (Maria Filomena); recommend merge.

bio: No separate Filomena Ferlaino married to Frank Cognetti can be found. The only child of Leopoldo Ferlaino and Giuseppina Fiorillo in the San Mango d'Aquino baptism registers is Maria Philumena (Filomena), born 8 October 1894 ([R4-S1]), who matches Helen's age and parents. FamilySearch attaches a sourceless 'Philomena Cognetti' to Frank ([R4-S2]). This entry is very probably Helen under her baptismal name.
